paper_cards.title: G0.5: One Autoregressive Stream for Robot Reasoning and Action
paper_cards.data: mixed robot/VQA pretraining; seven simulation and real evaluation regimes
paper_cards.method: one AR decoder, ActionCodec, native CoT, visual memory
paper_cards.novelty: reasoning and actions share one token stream and objective
paper_cards.limitations: training mixture coarsely disclosed; emergent prompt results small-sample

paper_cards.title: StellaVLA: In-Context Structured Demonstration for Generalizable Vision-Language-Action Models
paper_cards.data: VLA-Arena, LIBERO, LIBERO-Plus, real robot/human/XR demos
paper_cards.method: one retrieved trajectory converted to plan/subgoals/verbalized 3D motion
paper_cards.novelty: cross-embodiment structured in-context demo without fine-tuning
paper_cards.limitations: retrieval dependency; live rank may change

paper_cards.title: SLIM-0.5B: Learning Action-Grounded Predictive Latents for Robot Manipulation
paper_cards.method: masked future-latent and inverse-action prediction with compact MoT
paper_cards.novelty: 0.5B action-grounded latent policy without pixel generation
paper_cards.evidence: reported competitive LIBERO-Plus, latency, memory, and real evaluation
paper_cards.limitations: public code not confirmed; trial counts require audit

paper_cards.title: World Tokens: Enhancing Embodied Policies with Training-Time World Modeling
paper_cards.method: shared World Adapter conditions video denoiser and action expert; denoiser removed online
paper_cards.novelty: exclusive world-token routing distills dynamics into deployable policy context
paper_cards.evidence: best reported SIMPLER averages and R1 Pro gains over matched baseline

paper_cards.title: JEPA-WAM: Learning Vision-Language-Action Policies with Joint-Embedding World Modeling
paper_cards.method: spatially structured V-JEPA current/future target and shared transition/action predictor
paper_cards.novelty: dense patch-level predictive structure directly shapes action representation
paper_cards.evidence: 79.2% LIBERO-Plus without large policy pretraining; pi0.5 version 86.3%
paper_cards.limitations: pretrained representation dependency; no independent replication

paper_cards.title: Sekai2: From World Exploration to Interactive World Modeling
paper_cards.method: trajectory estimation/release plus hierarchical temporal annotation
paper_cards.novelty: long footage combines trajectories, semantics, and loop/revisit supervision
paper_cards.limitations: web-video bias; pose noise; access terms need audit
paper_cards.project_relevance: persistent spatial-memory and drift data substrate

paper_cards.title: Alaya-EVOKE: From Linear-Scaling Supervision to Endless World
paper_cards.data: long-horizon interactive video training/evaluation on WBench and VBench families
paper_cards.method: external camera-indexed world-state bank, linear/sparse teacher, three-step student
paper_cards.novelty: bounded online context with persistent external memory
paper_cards.evidence: reported WBench lead and 2.11 seconds per 1.5-second chunk
paper_cards.limitations: visual gate unresolved; slower than real time
